entry.title: Why can't gain envelope control points be deleted in Audacity 4?
entry.content: I added gain envelope control points on an audio clip. According to the Audacity 4 documentation, envelopes are a visual layer toggled via the Automation button, and gain envelopes are clip-based — they stay with the clip when moved or copied. However, once control points are added, they cannot be removed . The points persist on the clip and there is no apparent way to delete individual points or clear the entire envelope from a clip.
